sahil: HelixHealth (Dedicated) reporting p95 jump from ~200ms -> ~800ms after deploy at 2026-03-19 02:30 UTC. Support ticket: https://redwood.internal/s/TICKET-1423 (redacted). Can we triage?
maria: adding product. SLA tier? Any repro info?
tess (Support): Enterprise S1. No config change on customer side. We rolled redwood-13b-v1-quant into their dedicated pool at ~02:30 UTC. Logs in ticket.
kai: suspect quantization perf regression or kernel fallback. Need per-token traces, kernel selection logs, KV cache hit rates, batch size distribution.
aj: pulling infra metrics (queue length, GPU util). Assigning eng-runtime to lead.
maria: prioritization? Sales says customer may pause traffic if SLA not met.
sahil: critical. Helix target p95 <= 350ms. Legal wants mitigation plan in 24h, exec escalation in 72h if not resolved.
lee (Eng-Platform): mitigation: route 30% of traffic to hosted redwood-13b-v1 and scale pool +1 node. Proposed routing policy snippet provided.
kai: I'll run runtime traces and perf repro on staging. If kernel fallback, may need to pin/revert quant build. RC ETA 6-8h; patch 24-48h.
maria: acceptance criteria: p95 <= 350ms under load, smoke checks across top customers, canary+rollback plan, customer sign-off.
tess (Support): told customer we'll have mitigation in 2h and RCA/ETA in 8h. They're OK with staged routing.
sahil: mark P1 in backlog; escalate if >72h.
aj: infra metrics show queue latency spike ~02:28 UTC aligning with kernel-fallback notes. Upload: https://ci.redwood/metrics/helix-queue-2165000000 (redacted).
kai: starting perf repro; will update with traces in 2h.
deploy-bot: Canary routing change scheduled by lee at 2165000600.
maria: owners: kai (eng-runtime) RCA+patch, lee (eng-platform) routing mitigation, tess customer comms, maria product backlog. Targets: mitigation live in 2h, RCA/ETA in 8h. :thumbsup:
sahil: thanks, ping oncall if it escalates. @aj prep postmortem notes.
kai: ack, will post trace summary within 2h.
